STEP, SELECT, and what a mean percent is
The percentages below come from clinical trials of FDA-approved branded products. They do not describe compounded semaglutide or compounded tirzepatide, and they are not a promise of individual results. Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist. STEP 1 is the obesity trial most people mean: branded semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy), 68 weeks, about 14.9% versus 2.4% placebo. STEP 5 extended the time window.
